title: New Reform
statementMd:
Berland has $*n*$ cities connected by $*m*$ bidirectional roads. No road connects a city to itself, and each pair of cities is connected by no more than one road. It is **not guaranteed** that you can get from any city to any other one, using only the existing roads.

The President of Berland decided to make changes to the road system and instructed the Ministry of Transport to make this reform. Now, each road should be unidirectional (only lead from one city to another).

In order not to cause great resentment among residents, the reform needs to be conducted so that there can be as few separate cities as possible. A city is considered *separate*, if no road leads into it, while it is allowed to have roads leading from this city.

Help the Ministry of Transport to find the minimum possible number of separate cities after the reform.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two positive integers, $*n*$ and $*m*$ — the number of the cities and the number of roads in Berland ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$, $1 ≤ *m* ≤ 100 000$).

Next $*m*$ lines contain the descriptions of the roads: the $*i*$-th road is determined by two distinct integers $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $*x*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*i*}$), where $*x*_{*i*}$ and $*y*_{*i*}$ are the numbers of the cities connected by the $*i*$-th road.

It is guaranteed that there is no more than one road between each pair of cities, but it is not guaranteed that from any city you can get to any other one, using only roads.

## Output

Print a single integer — the minimum number of separated cities after the reform.

## Note

In the first sample the following road orientation is allowed: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5b18c46402af724bd3841d549d5d6f52fc16253.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/04481aced8a9d501ae5d785ab654c542ff5497a1.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0d220a75a508edc0d540dbaec5e198345049b66f.png).

The second sample: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5b18c46402af724bd3841d549d5d6f52fc16253.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/030fc9181b578c2d906254d38dc56da5554323eb.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a6011a68d6de05246ad6ba8aa24a5c5c71cd450a.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0d220a75a508edc0d540dbaec5e198345049b66f.png).

The third sample: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5b18c46402af724bd3841d549d5d6f52fc16253.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7113d83514735a488d7b85262585381d26986195.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/98300067e46d036076e429b208db829296ebca9d.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/146f3f3d208399fbab4d1d8c2800f07bf7b463e5.png).
statementZhMd:
伯兰有 $*n*$ 座城市，由 $*m*$ 条双向道路连接。没有道路连接城市自身，且任意一对城市之间至多有一条道路。**不保证**仅通过现有道路可以从任意一座城市到达另一座城市。

伯兰总统决定对道路系统进行改革，并指示交通部实施这项改革。现在，每条道路都应变为单向道路（只能从一座城市通往另一座城市）。

为了不引起居民的强烈不满，需要进行改革，使分离城市的数量尽可能少。如果一座城市没有任何道路通向它，但允许有道路从该城市通出，则称该城市为*分离城市*。

请帮助交通部求出改革后分离城市数量的最小可能值。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个正整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$ —— 伯兰的城市数量和道路数量（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 100 000$）。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行描述道路：第 $*i*$ 条道路由两个不同的整数 $*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*}$ 表示（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$*x*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*i*}$），其中 $*x*_{*i*}$ 和 $*y*_{*i*}$ 是由第 $*i*$ 条道路连接的城市编号。

保证任意一对城市之间至多有一条道路，但**不保证**仅通过道路可以从任意一座城市到达另一座城市。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数 —— 改革后分离城市数量的最小值。

## 说明

第一个样例中，可以采用如下的道路定向方式：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5b18c46402af724bd3841d549d5d6f52fc16253.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/04481aced8a9d501ae5d785ab654c542ff5497a1.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0d220a75a508edc0d540dbaec5e198345049b66f.png)。

第二个样例：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5b18c46402af724bd3841d549d5d6f52fc16253.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/030fc9181b578c2d906254d38dc56da5554323eb.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a6011a68d6de05246ad6ba8aa24a5c5c71cd450a.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0d220a75a508edc0d540dbaec5e198345049b66f.png)。

第三个样例：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e5b18c46402af724bd3841d549d5d6f52fc16253.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/29f71c065c3536e88b54429c734103ad3604f68b.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7113d83514735a488d7b85262585381d26986195.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/98300067e46d036076e429b208db829296ebca9d.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/146f3f3d208399fbab4d1d8c2800f07bf7b463e5.png)。
